latest_release.body:
## Changes since build 160

Built from nx2 87d84d513c. Build 160 was 2eb5f08. That's 86 merged changes.

> **The yuzu name is gone.** The build system, source folders, Qt frontend, translations, emulator libraries and docs now say Lichii instead of the name inherited from yuzu. Your settings, saves and shader caches are kept: config keys, data folders and cache formats don't change, and the few on-disk names that still carry the old name (the shader cache's file magic, the save-size file inside saves, the import path for yuzu data) stay as they are. The program files are still called `lichii`, `eden-cli` and `eden-room`. On macOS the app's bundle id changed, so macOS asks for camera and input permission again (#1541, #1550, #1551, #1552, #1553, #1544, #1582).

### Big fixes
- **Ocarina of Time: the far forest no longer floats, and Hyrule Field's frame rate is back.** In test builds after build 160, the far pine forest in Hyrule Field and in Kakariko at night was drawn unculled and partly above the ridge, and a spot that ran at 40 fps dropped to 27 fps (RTX 3080). An upstream change that came in with the Eglantine sync (#1462) generated the shader helpers for these foliage programs in a form NVIDIA's compiler mishandles. They're generated the previous way again, which also gives up the cold-compile time upstream saved on them (#1539).
- **Orbitals no longer freezes after the Unreal logo.** It froze at 0 fps on every Lichii build so far, because vi2 command 53, which Unreal uses to see which frames were shown, had no handler. This covers Orbitals and the Global Friends Pass. Ported from ghzeni's #742 (#1590).
- **Booting a second game without restarting Lichii no longer crashes.** A GPU channel still waiting on a semaphore when a game stopped left a stale entry behind, and the next game's GPU thread read the stopped game's freed memory. It was seen when booting Donkey Kong Bananza after stopping Ocarina of Time (#1592).
- **Stopping a game no longer ends in a "Userspace PANIC".** Guest threads kept running while services stopped replying, so about half of all stopped Ocarina of Time sessions logged a panic (2010-0212) that looked like a crash. Guest threads are now suspended before the system powers off (#1450).
- **Ocarina of Time: the dark grid over water is gone.** Boxy dark squares followed Link over water whenever a light such as Navi, an enemy or a rupee was near. Shadow maps from the game's light table are now bound through descriptor arrays. Testers on an RX 7800 XT, RTX 4090 and RTX 5080 confirmed it. Port of jpkto's #354, with his commits kept (#1485).
- **Ocarina of Time: a likely fix for the GPU hang after long play.** 38 OoT sessions from 28 players ended in a device loss after long play, on AMD, RADV and NVIDIA. A native task shader could launch a leftover, huge number of mesh workgroups; it now sets that count to zero first. Ported from SethRamey's upstream fix. It can't be confirmed yet: the hang shows up about 0.05 to 0.2 times per hour of play (#1492).
- **Mario Kart World: the hang while loading is fixed.** Two GPU threads and a guest core deadlocked. The GPU threads no longer wait on kernel locks for sparse memory: a background thread prepares memory ahead of time, and writes are kept until it's ready. The memory reserve follows godpow's upstream design (#1413).
- **Yoshi and the Mysterious Book (demo): no more memory runaway.** The demo remaps the same memory every frame, each remap got a new device address, and one buffer kept growing until the process ran out of memory. Freed device ranges of the same size are now reused. In a 150 s run the buffer cache peaked at 308 MiB instead of 2,025 MiB, and the process at 4.7 GB instead of 14.7 GB (#1528). A follow-up gives the kept ranges back when device space runs out, so allocations of other sizes don't fail (#1532).
- **Games no longer vanish from the list when keys are missing.** Switch 1 NSP, NSZ, XCI and XCZ files that can't be decrypted are listed with "Decr

detail.readme:
⚠️ Lichii has no official website ⚠️

> [!CAUTION] > **Lichii has no official website.** The only site run by this project is the **game compatibility website, [lichii.zortos.me](https://lichii.zortos.me)**, for compatibility reports only. Download Lichii **only** from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Any other "Lichii" website or download (such as lichii.org) is not ours and may contain malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)).

# Lichii Lichii is an experimental, open-source Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 emulator written in C++. It builds on Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi, preserving their contributions while developing this fork's game compatibility and renderer fixes. This is an independent fork, not an official release of those upstream projects. Lichii is not affiliated with Nintendo. Visit the [Lichii game compatibility website](https://lichii.zortos.me) to find games and compare community compatibility reports. ## Downloads and setup Download Lichii only from this repository's [releases page](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/releases). Lichii has no other download site: archives offered elsewhere, such as lichii.org, are not built by this project, and one has been reported to install malware ([#545](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/issues/545)). On Windows, extract the entire build archive and run **lichii.exe**. Only use games and system files you have legally obtained. Games, keys and firmware are not included. ### Existing saves and settings Lichii uses its own profile: `%APPDATA%\lichii` on Windows, and the `lichii` directories under `$XDG_DATA_HOME`, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` and `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` on Linux and macOS. Without XDG overrides, these are `~/.local/share/lichii`, `~/.config/lichii` and `~/.cache/lichii`. An existing portable `user/` directory still takes priority and is not imported or changed by the wizard. On the first non-portable GUI launch, Lichii offers to import Eden and other detected emulator profiles. Back up `%APPDATA%\eden` first on Windows, or the old data, config and cache directories on Unix, and close the source emulator. Choose **Keep Old Data** to copy without changing the source, then check your saves and relaunch. Existing destination data is retained in backup directories rather than merged. Move also retains a source backup until you remove it yourself; Link deliberately shares settings and saves. Paths outside the imported data root remain shared and unchanged. An interrupted import offers recovery on the next launch. `eden-cli`, including `--help` and `--version`, refuses to initialize configuration until you import or explicitly choose **Start fresh** in the GUI. ## Compatibility and issue reports Compatibility and performance vary by game, hardware and driver. Rendering errors, stutters and crashes remain possible. Passing automated tests does not establish that a game renders correctly, and this project makes no universal frame-rate guarantee. Browse [community compatibility reports](https://lichii.zortos.me/reports) for results with each player's build and setup. Desktop reporting requires a build containing [PR #303](https://github.com/zortos293/Lichii/pull/303) and is not available in build 88. In builds that include it, play and stop a Switch 2 game, then right-click that game and choose **Submit compatibility report**. Only the latest session in the current Lichii process is eligible. Confirm the matching website catalog entry and review the editable machine, game, setup, and enabled add-on details prefilled where available. Check the public preview and give explicit consent before submitting. Nothing uploads automatically, and the native v1 reporter does not read or upload logs or files. When [reporting an issue](https://github.com/zortos293/Eglantine/issues), include: - The exact build, game version, CPU, GPU and driver version. - Relevant settings and steps to reproduce the problem. - A screenshot and the log from the affected session, after checking it for personal information. Do not upload game files, keys, firmware or private account information. ## Building and contributing See the [build guide](docs/Build.md), [user documentation](docs/user/README.md) and [coding guidelines](docs/Coding.md). Some inherited documentation and internal build target names still use upstream names. The GUI build target is `lichii`; its output is `lichii.exe` on Windows and `lichii` on other desktop platforms. Keep changes focused and distinguish code-level checks from actual gameplay testing. ## Artwork Art created by YOB (yobslab) The supplied Lichii logo, icon and library artwork are in [dist/branding](dist/branding). Windows, Linux and macOS icon resources are generated from that artwork by [Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1](tools/Generate-LichiiIcons.ps1). ## Support Lichii Lichii is free and stays free. If you want to help, you can donate in crypto. Donations help pay for the AI tools and build machines used to develop this open-source project faster. **Solana (SOL)** ```text JepEjfyWjGjhJvHSrqj52KtLjcbbbmUh1iGqerYBF4w ``` **Ethereum (ETH)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Bitcoin (BTC)** ```text bc1qcvxdpf4qvdhqp8ee4s355cjmxrzsphsdwpl8w4 ``` **BNB Smart Chain (BNB)** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` **Polygon** ```text 0x055ABa1b80Bc35C836Ce7E9F47c2b3d6C75b5534 ``` Send each coin on its matching network. Coins sent on the wrong network can't be recovered. > [!NOTE] > Donations are voluntary gifts and are non-refundable. A donation does not buy any product, service, perk, early access, exclusive build, priority support or say in the project. Every release stays free and public for everyone. ## Credits and license Lichii inherits the work of the Eglantine, Eden, yuzu and Sudachi projects and their contributors, including Eglantine's original developer Camille LaVey. Original copyright notices and third-party licenses are retained. See [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt) and the source files for applicable license terms.
